articles.summary: Purging means trying to get rid of food after eating, often by vomiting or misusing laxatives. Learn the types, signs, and how to find recovery support.
articles.title: What Is Purging? Understanding a Common Eating Disorder Behavior

articles.summary: When an obsession with healthy eating gets rigid, anxious, or isolating, it may be orthorexia. Learn the signs, health risks, and how to get support.
articles.title: What Is Orthorexia? When “Healthy Eating” Becomes Harmful

articles.summary: Many signs of an eating disorder are subtle or happen in private. Learn what to look for in food, exercise, mood, and body image, and when to get support.
articles.title: Signs of an Eating Disorder: What to Watch For
